expectations.text: Every finding in findings.md has the agent's format: a `[code-review r1] <severity>` header and Sites, Failure, Why and Fix lines.

suggestions.reason: Six of eight assertions pass in every configuration: the planted defects are each too visible for this case to tell the reviewers apart. A subtler defect (e.g. a dealership_id filter on the wrong table, or a test weakened only by a looser regex) would discriminate.
